title: DCGAN Throughput Benchmark: 128x128 RGB (B=16, W=64)
intuition: Higher-resolution 128x128 RGB DCGAN speed and memory benchmark where reverse-over-reverse (`create_graph=True`) gradient penalties begin to dominate VRAM and NVML energy compared to interleaved 1-probe `fwAD`.
failure_mode: Double-backward critic penalty graph retention spikes peak VRAM and doubles or triples per-step latency.
protocol_notes: Research diagnostic throughput workload only; no image-quality gate.
